tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// 'gro dus kyi lam gtor dang*/ gtor 'bul bsdus pa bzhugs//

gtor ma bya khyi phyi mi la mi sbyin dngos grub bya/ gtor ma ma 'dzom na phud rgod 'bru sna btab pa so sor bya ba lags so// dmar gtor 'bri mog byug pa lnga tshom mam/ rang rang so so'i gtor ma so sor 'bul ba 'dzom na'am/ yang na spyir gcig gam/ tha ma mar thud sogs la bsngos kyang chog /gtor ma yin na 'gug gzhug bya ba ni/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum gyi bka' bden pas/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gi tshe bsod kha rje la gnod byed thams cad gtor ma 'di la khug cig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lan gsum/ dmar gtor ram mar thud gang yin yang*/ gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ a kā ro sogs/ oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha h+ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥdzaḥ ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis bsngos nas bskul ba ni/ hrīḥ dur khrod rab 'jigs me dpung nang*// keng rus sha khrag rgya mtshor 'khyil// sha za gcan zan mang po'i gnas/ khro bcu rgyu bar mi nus shing*// phyag na rdo rje skyi g.ya'i gnas// de 'dra'i gnas mchog dam pa nas// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi gtso// dbang chen yab yum 'dir gshegs shig /yab yum sku yi 'khor lo la// mkha' 'gro 'bum tsho nyi shu rdzogs// bskul lo gtso bo las la bskul// sha khrag dmar gtor 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// bh+yo/ gzhan yang ye shes snod bcud dang*// phyi nang gsang ba grub pa'i tshogs// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas rnams nyul// sras dang phra men dbang phyug gtso// sku mdog phyag mtshan ma nges te// gri gug thod khrag kha ṭ+wāṃ dang*// rnge'u chung brdeg 'joms mtshon cha 'dzin// ske rags dril chung g.yer khas brgyan// dar 'phyang rus pa'i rgyan drug mdzes// dbu rgyan dar gyi cod pan can// rlung gis bskyod cing pu ru ru// rkang pa rdo rje'i sgeg 'gros can// mkha' la thogs med bun bun rgyu// lag pa gser gyi gdu bu can// sna tshogs gar byed khyugs se khyug

/phrin las gcig tu ma nges te// 'phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med sgrub// dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la// ci bsam phrin las 'grub par mdzod// dzam dmar yab yum tsho gcig ni/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye ku ru kul+le hrīḥdz+nyā na kīrti sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta la khā hi/ hūm̐/ dpal ldan mgon po dzam+bha la// myur du drag tu bskul ba'i tshe// sku mdog dmar la 'od zer 'phro// phyag g.yas rin chen thod khrag bsnams// g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le btsir// zhabs gnyis a par tsi ta gzir// dar dang rin chen rgyan cha 'khrol// 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes// thugs dam dam bcas dus la babs// dgos 'dod dngos grub char ltar phob// bcol pa'i phrin las myur 'grub mdzod// las byed mkha' 'gro sku mdog dmar// gcer bu me tog dmar po dang*// dar dmar rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes// phyag na lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin// ku ru kul+le'i sprul pa ste// bse lang mkha' 'gro'i ngo bo nyid// bye ba dung phyur 'jig rten gang*// 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes// snang srid thams cad dbang du sdus// dgos 'dod dngos grub char ltar phob// hūm̐/ gling bzhi byang phyogs gser ri bdun gyi rtse// rin chen sna bdun brtsegs pa'i lding khang nas// rnam thos bu yi bang mdzod gnyer kha ba// gnod sbyin dbang po gzhan gyis mi thub pa// 'dir gshegs dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes// mnga' thang stobs dang 'byor pa'i dngos grub stsol// hūm̐/ stong gsum 'dzam gling dbang bsgyur rdzu 'phrul can// nor lha kun gyi pho nya myur mgyogs can// nor gyi bdag po dge bsnyen ye shes grags// 'dir gshegs dkar gsum brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes// snang gsal pra dang longs spyod dngos grub stsol// rnam sras mdung dmar can ni/ oṃ ma hā rā dza yak+ṣa sa ma ya bai shra ma ṇa ye sarba rat+na tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dza dzaḥ

ma hā ba liṃ ta la khā hi/ hūm̐/ ri rab lhun po'i byang phyogs nas// lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog nas// rin chen 'bar ba'i pho brang nas// rnam sras 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol// rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras// stong gsum rin chen gter gyi bdag /gling bzhi byang phyogs skyong tsa na// phrin las bzhi la mnga' brnyes pa// in+d+ra nī la'i mdangs dang ldan// sa brgyad sems dpar bzhugs pa po// gnod sbyin pho mo mang po dang*// klu yi ded dpon mdzad tsa na// rin chen gser gyi kha dog can// ḍā ki ma dang klu mo dang*// bdud mo'i ded dpon mdzad tsa na// bai ḍūr sngon po'i sku mdog can// snang srid dbang du sdud pa dang*// 'gro ba'i rnam shes 'gugs pa'i tshe// pad+ma rā ga'i mdog 'dra zhing*// mi'u thung gi cha lugs la// le brgan dar gyi cod pan can// sku la bse khrab dmar po gsol// dbu la bse rmog rgya zhu gsol// phyag g.yas mdung dar rgyal mtshan bsnams// srid gsum zil gyis gnon par mdzad// phyag g.yon ne'u le lcags kyu bsnams// 'gro ba'i rnam shes dbang du sdud// sku las 'od zer dmar po 'phros// srid pa gsum yang dbang du sdud// 'gro ba mi yi rnam shes 'gugs// sbyin bdag rnams kyi snying lag bsgul// g.yang can nor dang brjid can gos// bcud can zas la sogs pa yi// bdag la zas nor longs spyod kyi// dngos grub ma lus bstsal du gsol// nor bdag rgyal po chen po yi// thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i tshe/ khyod kyi sprul pa'i rgyal phran ni// 'gro ba mi yi snying la zhugs// rnam shes sgyur la dbang du sdus// 'jig rten khams kyi longs spyod rnams// ma lus thams cad dbang sdus la// sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol// hūm̐/ shar phyogs mgon po dpal rab 'chang*// nyi ma'i sras po 'phags pa re man+ta// zla ba'i sras po rta bdag ku bai ra// 'dir gshegs dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes// rngog chags 'phel srung lam dgra rta nad zlogs//

de nas dam can ni/ kye/ nyi ma nub phyogs pha ki na// pha ni bdud la ma ni dmu// dmu bdud bshos pa'i mthu rtsal can// skyes bu dge bsnyen chen po ste// zhwa yi mgon po ra rta can// gnod sbyin nor bdag mthu rtsal can// gter bdag mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul can// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar// phyag g.yas lcags kyus mi nor 'gugs// phyag g.yon ne'u les dbul phongs sel// phyed bskum rin chen sna lngas brgyan// kong btsun gnyen dang gnyis su med// brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor gyis bskor// sku mched sum brgya drug cu dang*// the'u rang dmag dpon rdzu 'phrul can// rdzu 'phrul skad cig stong gsum bskor// 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes// 'jig rten khams kyi nor la spyod/ khyod kyi thugs dam dus la babs// mi nor zas gsum dbang du sdus// rnal 'byor bdag la dngos grub stsol// oṃ badz+ra sā dhu sa ma ya badz+ra li la ma ba liṃ ta khā hi/ kye/ dam can skyes bu chen po/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul gyi bdag po/ bdag la byang chub sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen dang*/ khyed bsgrub cing mchod pa'i yo byad dang ma ldan pas/ mi snying sgul cig /mi sems g.yos shig /snang ba sgyur cig /bdag la g.yang can gyi nor stsol cig /brjid can gyi gos bskon cig /bcud chen gyi zas sdus shig /'bru dang nas kyi char phob cig /skyes bu chen po rem zhig /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul rtsal dang nus pa da lta blta'o// de nas sman btsun lcam sring ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gtor ma lha'i zhal zas su gyur/ oṃ badz+ra pra mo ha hriṃ hriṃ dza dzaḥ oṃ bhi shu tsa na sa ma ya khrag ta ku bu tsa ra na hūm̐ hūm̐ na ru tsa/ rdo rje g.yu sgron ma/ skyes bu lung btsan lcam sring 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bdag gi 'dod don thams cad 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ hūm̐/ steng phyogs dag pa 'phrul gyi gzhal yas nas// rin chen sprin dkar brtsegs pa'i gur nang nas// rdo rje g.yu sgron sman btsun 'khor dang bcas// 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes su gsol// bcol ba'i phrin las ma lus 'grub par mdzod// oṃ badz+ra pra mo ha hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥdzaḥ

ma mā la lā li lī sring 'gro hūm̐ sid+dhi puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ mi nor zas gsum puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ ngan ne ma ni/ bh+yo/ bsil ba tshal dang nye ba'i tshan+dho ha// bden bral mun pa can gyi dur khrod nas// dkor gyi srung ma rdo rje ngan ne ma// 'dir gshegs dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes// dkor rnams srung zhing spel ba'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ ra li pra ma ya i daṃ ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes rā ga a s+yas bsgrigs pa dge'o// maṅga laṃ/// /
